what.text: This page follows people from Afghanistan in Turkmenistan whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3200 Afghan people in need of international protection in Turkmenistan, 0.3% of all people in need of international protection from Afghanistan.
Refugees from Afghanistan, a separate group, live mostly in Pakistan, Iran, Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 2020 to 2025, and armed conflict with the Islamic State group in the same years.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's data has a figure for this group in Turkmenistan for 2025 only.
So the data shows no change over time for this group.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Turkmenistan.
These are year-end totals for Turkmenistan only, and the group is never added to refugees.
